title: Sociolinguistically Informed Interpretability: A Case Study on Hinglish Emotion Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Using LIME (Local Interpretable Model-Agnostic Explanations) to calculate token-level importance scores, tagging tokens by language (Hindi, English, or Other) in code-mixed text, and statistically analyzing (via Chi-square and ANOVA) the dependency between the token's language identity and the model's emotional polarity predictions (e.g., associating English tokens with positive emotions and Hindi tokens with negative emotions).
